evidence.observation: Tube pressure gauge is not installed; required growth-stage pressure verification is unavailable.
Exhaust O2 was 6.5 ppm at the start of growth.
Exhaust O2 has risen progressively through 12.3, 16.2 and 19.5 to 25.7 ppm during growth; this raises concern about the atmosphere but does not identify a cause.
Temperature 749.9 °C and Ar 100.7 sccm track their setpoints, but pressure is unavailable.

args.missing_evidence: A valid tube-pressure measurement and growth-stage atmosphere acceptance limits are needed to verify execution; investigate the rising O2 with independent atmosphere and leak/exhaust checks. No sample characterization is available.
